title: From Questioned Trade to Championship Redemption: Karl-Anthony Towns' Journey
description:
On October 2, 2024, the Knicks shocked the basketball world by trading Julius Randle and Donte DiVincenzo for Karl-Anthony Towns just days before the season began. The move was immediately criticized. Towns had won only two playoff series in nine NBA seasons. He was labeled soft, defensively limited, unable to win when it mattered. By April 2026, after a zero-point playoff performance, the trade looked catastrophic.

But something changed. Towns elevated his game, led the Knicks on an 11-game playoff win streak, dominated the Eastern Conference Finals, and outplayed Victor Wembanyama in the NBA Finals. His +258 playoff plus-minus set a record. On June 13, 2026, he delivered the Knicks their first championship in 53 years. This is the story of how a questioned trade became a championship masterpiece, and how a player transformed his legacy in the most pressure-packed arena in basketball.
